notes.title: Pharaonic Update 3 - Gameplay improvements
notes.notes:
Welcome again, fellow warriors!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11696883/906b728adc089f1fdd6ada36a955724ea51180e1.jpg[/img]

This update brings a few improvements that fix one of the most important unconveniences with the game: Having to repeat arenas when traversing already complete zones.

We've been thinking about possible solutions to this (didn't want to remove the enemies alltogether once you clear an arena), and we finally decided to do the following: Once you clear an arena, next time it will still spawn a few enemies (usually 2-4 of them), but the area won't be locked anymore.

This means the game has become a little easier and shorter (no need to repeat all the previous arenas), but it should be a better experience overall.

Not every arena have this feature, but all the ones that are in the main path have it.

[b]Gameplay changes[/b]
[list][*]Cleared arenas in the main path do not lock the player in posterior attempts.
[*]Spearmen charge attack in Thebes/Palace is no longer unblockable.
[*]You now get a 25% stamina boost when performing a successful parry.
[/list]

We've also made a brand new trailer, more spectacular and fast-paced than the previous one. Check it out in the store page!

notes.title: Pharaonic Update 1
notes.notes:
First update since the game was released, so we're giving version number a reset :D.

[img]http://www.milkstonestudios.com/uploads/Pharaonic_PraiseTheSun.png[/img]

This update fixes a few bugs and includes some performance improvements and gameplay changes, after feedback from the community.

By the way, we've posted some information on how to enable Photo Mode so you can get nice pictures. It's the same tool we used for the store screenshots, it's rather powerful so feel free to try around :) . Information here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/386080/discussions/1/364040166688595605/

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a teleport in the final area.
[*]Done some performance improvements that should improve framerate and loading times.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased parry window for both light and heavy shields, now it should be a bit easier to perform them.
[*]Increased dodge window a bit when dodging in place or rolling forward.
[*]Receiving damage from an unblockable hit will now stun you.
[*]Reduced Lapis helmet defense from 50 to 30 (it was a bug).
[*]Reduced difficulty of the last combat in the palace (12 golems instead of 16)
[*]Increased difficulty of the final boss (around 15% more health, increased health of spawned golems, increased attack variety, increased damage of some attacks, increased a bit attack rate).
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Oannes' teleport not working properly (and not counting towards the achievement)
[*]Fixed not getting the proper ending.
[*]Fixed some sounds in cutscenes ignoring volume settings
[*]"Fixed" errors on Linux related to mouse button input (It's an engine issue, we just ignore those buttons now)
[/list]

notes.title: Pharaonic Update 12 - Big Update! New attack animations, trading cards, and plenty more
notes.notes:
This week's update is a big one, the main addition being new attack animations for dagger/thrust weapons and really heavy weapons (hammers, etc).

[img]http://www.milkstonestudios.com/uploads/PharaonicBloom.jpg[/img]

Moreover, we have finished doing the trading cards for the game and we've just enabled them. Not sure if your past playtime counts towards getting them, but anyway it's a good reason to give the game a try again :)

There're also lots of minor improvements and bugfixes, specially on the graphics postprocessing side, with improved ambient occlusion and bloom effects.

We hope to have most remaining lore by next week, as well as the final boss (which it's already finished, but we're waiting until we have the game ending cutscenes ready so you don't miss them!)

[b]New features:[/b]
[list][*]New attack animations for thrust weapons (dagger, straight swords) and heavy weapons (hammers, big axes).
[*]Added Steam trading cards
[*]New achievements for the late part of the game (not all of them can be unlocked yet)
[*]Changed Ambient Occlusion effect (now it's stronger, giving the game a darker vibe).
[*]Improved Bloom effect, specially on High and Very High settings.
[*]Done some performance improvements, reducing CPU usage by up to 10%.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Now it's slightly easier to perform parries. Also you can start your attack faster after performing a parry.
[*]Adjusted attack combos for some weapons so they are a bit faster and less sluggish.
[*]Done many weapon numbers adjustments to match the new animations.
[*]The list of teleport locations has been inverted (so later locations are shown on top).
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed framerate drops when activating a Heka Stele
[*]Fixed area attacks being blockable / dodgeable when not intended.
[*]Fixed some voice issues.
[*]Fixed some arrow attacks causing damage when the shield is up.
[*]Fixed some text issues on the Character creation section.
[*]Fixed minor translation issues.
[/list]

notes.notes:

[*]Added more UI Improvements.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an animation speed issue with some backpacks.
[*]Fixed camera issues when using levers on the City of Thebes.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
[list]

[*]A weapon (Palace Golem Katar) has been removed from the game, and replaced by a sword. If you had the old weapon it will be removed from your inventory. Sorry!

notes.title: Pharaonic Update 7 - The Royal Palace opens its gates!
notes.notes:
The Royal Palace is finally available for you to explore. Although the main layout and enemy locations are done, some things are still work in progress, namely NPC dialogue, item descriptions and some enemy animations.

Another big change is the update of every backpack model. We felt that the previous backpacks didn't fit well with the style of the armor sets, so we've replaced them with some really cool amulets (some of the textures are still being worked on, though).

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3ornjJoJ07Mz406teo/giphy.gif[/img]

There are also three brand new backpacks for you to try!

[b]New Features:[/b]
[list][*]Royal Palace area is available (enemies, chests, new items, etc.)
[*]Three new backpacks (2 offensive ones and 1 support backpack)
[*]Improved backpack models. Text descriptions have not been changed yet.
[*]Finished plenty of textures for enemies and equipment.
[*]Added new animation and effects to the intro cutscene
[*]Improved surround sound (music and ambient sound should sound better on surround speakers)
[*]Updated loading screens (now they shown the area that's being loaded)
[*]Main Quest on the Quest Log (so that you can remember easier what's your next goal)
[*]Improved a bit camera behavior when you are static. It can even be moved a bit by using the right stick of the gamepad.
[*]Redone some of the spearmen attack animations
[/list]

[b]Gameplay Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the location of many Teleport Steles so that they're in more convenient spots.
[*]Improved attack conditions of the enemy animations added in the last update.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Tutorials didn't appear when intended
[*]A Teleport Stele in the Halls of Stone didn't work properly
[/list]

We've also been working on the pyramid area that you'll access through Thebes (some of you have even walked around it because of a mistake of ours). [*]Updated to the latest Unity version, should have fixed graphical glitches on Linux.

notes.title: Pharaonic Update 4 - City of Thebes and Achievements!
notes.notes:
Today's update brings the City of Thebes. Although it's not fully finished yet (all the lore and item descriptions is missing, most equipment has still a placeholder texture, and the enemy animations aren't done yet), it should be playable and enjoyable.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l4KhQR3GsiRbnrwcw/giphy.gif[/img]

We've also finished the intro for the first boss in the game, The Warden. You sure don't want to mess with this guy!

This update also brings Achievements to the game. There's plenty of them, and while most of them should be obtained just by playing the game, a few of them can only be unlocked on specific conditions, as well as a few secret ones (don't worry, they shouldn't be too hard to unlock).

Since we've focused on preparing the new content this week, there are no bugfixes or gameplay changes worth mentioning.

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Opened the City of Thebes area, with new enemies, equipment, quests, etc.
[*]Done the Warden boss intro.
[*]Added achievements. Icons are temporary, we'll update them later.
[/list]

notes.title: Pharaonic Update 3 - Minor bugfixes and improvements
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, new update today! We've been working hard on the new area (the city of Thebes), and most of the gameplay is almost ready, but the art is still halfway done and some parts of the scenario are really ugly, so we'll probably wait until next week to open this area to you.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/NM11xt7y68KK4/giphy.gif[/img]

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*]New NPC interaction animations (still not finished)
[*]Improved Oannes scenario art and lighting
[*]Finished Oannes and her minions' particle effects
[*]Done some geometry batching that should noticeably improve performance on some scenarios (by around 15-25%). This might cause some issues with dynamic elements, so please report if you find something.
[*]Added new loading tips explaining in more detail some of the game mechanics.
[*]Added a new tip on the Dungeon level explaining the Guard Break mechanic.
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed particle bug after picking up our corpse
[*]Fixed some camera issues on specific points of Avaris
[*]Now a ring passive buff is properly removed when removing the ring.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed how weight affects stamina: The stamina reduction is halved, but stamina regeneration is still lower. In other words, the stamina pool is bigger, but regeneration stays the same.
[*]Changed a bit some arenas on the Halls of Stone, to add more enemy variety
[*]Increased The Warden boss difficulty (damage and health).
[*]Increased Level Cap to 30.
[*]Maximum stamina increase a bit more when leveling up (around 10%)
[/list]

notes.title: Pharaonic Update 2 - Oannes and some gameplay changes
notes.notes:
New update! This one brings a few new features that we hope you will find useful or interesting, as well as completed animations and gameplay of Oannes, the fourth boss of the game.

[img]http://www.milkstonestudios.com/uploads/images/PharaonicOannes.jpg[/img]

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Oannes: Balanced gameplay and done animations.
[*]Oannes: Added reward chest and teleport.
[*]Avaris: Added a chest where you can find the map.
[*]Corpse retrieving: Now you can recover your lost experience if you manage to go back to the point where you had died. (Still a bit experimental).
[*]Big Head mode: If you name your hero as "Chibi" you will start in Big Head mode. It's fun! :)
[/list]
[img]http://www.milkstonestudios.com/uploads/images/PharaonicBigHead.jpg[/img]
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug in Croftnefer / Pratchnefer quest line (the mother wouldn't give you the reward)
[*]Fixed weapon attack speed affecting spell cast speed
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced hit knockback when blocking with a heavy shield.
[*]Increased a bit the active time of dodging, so it's a bit easier to evade hits
[*]Added a red weight icon on the stamina stat, so it's more clear that equipment weight reduces stamina
[/list]

But we are not just working on these minor changes, we have also started work on the next area (the city of Thebes). While there's still a lot of work left before it's ready to be tested, it's coming along pretty nicely :)

[img]http://www.milkstonestudios.com/uploads/images/PharaonicCity.jpg[/img]
[i]Remember, this scenario is still work in progress![/i]

notes.title: Pharaonic Update 1 - Bugfixes and minor changes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we hope you had a blast playing Pharaonic! :)

We have prepared a small update fixing a few bugs and issues that were found or reported during this weekend. It's a short list, but rest assured, more and bigger updates will come.

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added option to disable Chromatic Aberration (it was tied to Quality before). We'll probably play around with this effect a bit, our intention is to have a subtle natural effect that doesn't get annoying.
[/list]
[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Should have fixed the gray dot pattern issue with Ambient Occlusion and Radeon GPUs.
[/list]
[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed a bit the enemy layout on the Nile Delta area to make the fights a bit more varied.
[*]Improved a bit the UI Auto-hide behavior, so it doesn't hide as fast, and is shown on specific actions (Healing, Changing equipment...). We may add a switch in the future if people still asks for one.
[/list]

Don't forget to pass by the forums and leave your feedback there, we are eager to hear your comments! ːwnohannahː
